title: A charged-off loan's fee chargeback credits FUND_SOURCE 280.00, debits CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE 250.00, then debits INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_FEES 30.00 (loan 17 L113)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the charged-off journal entry a loan CHARGEBACK posted, the fee shape, on the Tier-D Part2 MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_DOWNPAYMENT_ADV_PMT_ALLOC_PROG_SCHEDULE_HOR_INST_LVL_DELINQUENCY_CREDIT_ALLOCATION). request.chargeback_journal.amount is the accepted chargeback request transactionAmount 280.0 -> "28000" minor units, raised with paymentTypeId 2 (loans/loan-17/loan-17-chargeback-request.json); transaction_id L113 is the sweep's transactionId for the read-back's transaction id 113 (type Chargeback). request.chargeback_journal.portions transcribes the read-back's chargeback transaction id 113: principalPortion 250.0 -> "25000", feeChargesPortion 30.0 -> "3000", penaltyChargesPortion 0.0 -> "0", overpaymentPortion 0.0 -> "0"; the observed identity amount = principal + fee + penalty + overpayment holds (28000 = 25000 + 3000 + 0 + 0). request.chargeback_journal.charged_off is the read-back's top-level chargedOff true (fraud false); when charged off getPrincipalAccount / getFeeAccount / getPenaltyAccount resolve CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE / INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_FEES / INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_PENALTY. request.chargeback_journal.accounts transcribes the product mapping LP2_DOWNPAYMENT_ADV_PMT_ALLOC_PROG_SCHEDULE_HOR_INST_LVL_DELINQUENCY_CREDIT_ALLOCATION: fundSourceAccountId 6, loanPortfolioAccountId 5, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 17, receivableFee/PenaltyAccountId 10, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 16, incomeFromChargeOffFees/PenaltyAccountId 14; paymentTypeId 2 has no channel mapping (the one channel mapping is paymentTypeId 1 -> 19), so the default FUND_SOURCE 6 applies, exactly the account the observed credit names. expect.chargeback_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the 3 L113 legs in id order: JE 248 CREDIT account 6 280.0, JE 249 DEBIT account 16 250.0, JE 250 DEBIT account 14 30.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: on a charged-off loan the principal debit switches from LOAN_PORTFOLIO 5 to CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE 16 AND the fee debit switches from FEES_RECEIVABLE 10 to INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_FEES 14. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
